text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Dober is feeling under the weather, so I send her to the infirmary to rest.
choice_data_list: Don't push yourself too hard. Just rest.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I'm not pushing myself… Anyway, later.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Sorry about this… I'll try to recover as soon as possible.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Where am I? Wait a second…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Where am I? Wait a second…

text_block_list.name: Protagonist
text_block_list.text: Is it true that you got a modeling contract and you're moving abroad?!

text_block_list.name: Crush
text_block_list.text: Yeah… But I can't stand to be away from you! Won't you come with me?

text_block_list.name: Protagonist
text_block_list.text: What?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Wh-what's happening?! Those two are from the manga I drew!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: The protagonist races in the Twinkle Series, but an upperclassman she admires who's a popular model invites her to move abroad…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I couldn't decide whether she should chase after her love or her dream, so I just stopped writing…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: …I wonder how things pan out for the two of them.

text_block_list.name: Protagonist
text_block_list.text: I don't want to be apart from you either. But I also can't give up my dream of reaching the top of the Twinkle Series!

text_block_list.name: Protagonist
text_block_list.text: I'll run so well in my races that you'll see me on TV and online every day, no matter where in the world you are!

text_block_list.name: Protagonist
text_block_list.text: And I want to see you too, so work hard and make it big! Then, one day, you'll come back for me, won't you?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I see…

text_block_list.name: Crush
text_block_list.text: So that's your answer.

text_block_list.name: Crush
text_block_list.text: All right… We'll be together even though we're apart! Let's both achieve our dreams!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Wah?! W-was that a dream?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: So that's what happens… Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Good luck, you two… I'll do my best too.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It seems Mejiro Dober is able to fully recover from her exhaustion and returns to her normal self.

text_block_list.name: Protagonist
text_block_list.text: So I'll destroy this world for tearing the two of us apart!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: What?!

text_block_list.name: Crush
text_block_list.text: I can't believe it… My selfishness in wanting to keep you close to me has turned you into an evil queen!

text_block_list.name: Crush
text_block_list.text: This is my doing… As the hero, I'll take you down myself!

text_block_list.name: Protagonist
text_block_list.text: Heh heh… I won't let that happen. You'll be living with me in the world I'll create for just the two of us!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Agh! Stop! This makes no sense!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Wah?! W-was that a dream?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Ugh… Thank goodness that wasn't real… Worst plot twist I've ever seen!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Dober is so shaken that she doesn't get any meaningful rest, mentally or physically.
